# TimeDoco — Privacy-First Time Tracker

> TimeDoco is a 100% client-side, privacy-first time tracking web application. Data is stored strictly on-device in browser IndexedDB with no account, server, telemetry, or tracking.

## Core Pages & App

- [Landing Page](https://timedoco.com/): Feature breakdown, Toggl/Harvest privacy comparison, and overview of client-side tracking.
- [TimeDoco Web App](https://timedoco.com/app/): The full time tracking application interface (timer, timesheet matrix, analysis/PDF reports, grouping management).
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://timedoco.com/faq/): Questions and answers regarding IndexedDB local storage, PDF/CSV/ICS exports, multi-currency options, and offline PWA capability.
- [Blog Index](https://timedoco.com/blog/): Articles and guides for contractors, freelancers, and privacy advocates.
- [Privacy Policy](https://timedoco.com/privacy/): Details on 100% client-side storage, zero server tracking, zero analytics, and hosting disclaimers.
- [Terms of Use](https://timedoco.com/terms/): Terms governing application usage, user backup responsibilities, tax disclaimers, and warranty limitations.

## Articles

- [Introducing TimeDoco: The Time Tracker I Couldn't Find, So I Built It](https://timedoco.com/blog/introducing-timedoco/): Welcome post detailing why TimeDoco was built, what it does, and its core privacy-first features.
- [Why Client-Side Privacy Matters for Contractors](https://timedoco.com/blog/why-client-side-privacy-matters/): Deep dive into client data confidentiality and zero cloud vulnerability.
